NewsArticle.Title: Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: 04.04 10:41 - 10:52 PDT Dark Ages servers was down for scheduled maintenance 10:41 a.m. - 10:52 a.m. PDT Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
